name: microstructure_volume_reversion_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when a 5-second bar prints with volume exceeding 3x the prior 5-minute rolling average but the bar range stays below 0.03% of spot (~7 pts at NIFTY 24,000), a large institutional VWAP or TWAP program order is being absorbed — two-sided matching or contra-flow liquidity suppresses price movement while the order is filled. The bar's direction (close > open = buy-side absorption, close < open = sell-side absorption) reveals which side is winning. Once the program order completes, market makers who were absorbing it delta-hedge and momentum algos pile in, generating a directional move of 6-12 NIFTY spot points within the next 30-90 seconds.

indicators.name: vol_mean_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling mean volume. NOT blindly scaled from original's 20-bar 1-min window (which would give 240 bars = 20 min). At 5-second frequency, intraday volume regimes shift every few minutes — a 5-minute baseline (60 bars) captures the current activity level without smoothing over session structure changes. We need a local reference, not a session-wide one.

indicators.name: vol_ratio
indicators.purpose: Measures current bar volume relative to recent 5-minute average. Threshold 3x (lower than original's 5x) because 5-second bar volume is noisier than 1-minute bar volume; a 3x spike on 5s is statistically as significant as 5x on 1-min.

indicators.name: bar_range_pct
indicators.purpose: Bar range as % of open price. Threshold 0.03% (~7 pts at NIFTY 24,000) identifies bars where price barely moved despite high volume — the defining signature of order absorption. Original used 0.15% on 1-min bars; scaling proportionally to 5-second bars (which have 1/12 the typical range) gives ~0.013% but we use 0.03% to accommodate some noise in the bar open/close.

indicators.name: bar_direction
indicators.purpose: Direction of the absorption bar: +1 = buy-side absorbing supply (bullish), -1 = sell-side absorbing demand (bearish). This is the directional signal.

conditions: bar_range_pct < 0.03 (range < 7 NIFTY points — absorption, not a directional move)
bar_direction == +1 (close > open — buy-side is absorbing supply)
VIX < 25 (avoid extreme volatility regime where absorption signals are noise)
time between 09:25 and 15:20 IST (skip opening noise and near EOD)
buy_ce.confirmation: enter at close of the absorption bar

conditions: bar_direction == -1 (close < open — sell-side is absorbing demand)
buy_pe.confirmation: enter at close of the absorption bar

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option pts (≈6 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). NIFTY absorption resolutions should begin within 1-2 bars; if price moves 6 spot pts against us, the absorption thesis is wrong and we are in a directional move against our position. At 30-90 second holds, a 6 spot pt adverse move is already 1-2 standard deviations of the expected session move.
exit.target_rationale: 5 option pts (≈10 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). Post-absorption directional resolutions on NIFTY typically extend 8-14 spot pts in 30-90 seconds as market makers delta-hedge and momentum algos confirm. Targeting 10 pts captures the lower half of the expected resolution range, giving 1:1.67 risk-reward with a tight stop.

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 25 — above this, index volume patterns are dominated by macro panic and absorption signals are unreliable
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST — skip first 10 min (opening volume is structurally elevated; 5x spikes are routine and not absorption) and last 10 min before expiry flatten
filters.trend_filter: none — absorption is a microstructure event, can occur in any trend regime
filters.spread_filter: none — NIFTY index volume proxied by futures has consistent tick quality

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — institutional block trading via VWAP/TWAP is standard practice and slow to change; however, signal frequency is low (2-6 trades/day) limiting daily P&L

adaptation_notes: Original: volume spike >5x on NIFTY50 individual stocks with range <0.15% on 1-min bars, hold 5-20 min. Converted changes: (1) Universe from individual stocks to NIFTY index — same absorption thesis but operating on aggregate institutional flow rather than single-stock block trades; (2) vol_threshold lowered from 5x to 3x because 5-second bars are noisier, the same statistical significance is achieved at a lower multiplier; (3) range_pct_threshold lowered from 0.15% to 0.03% because 5-second NIFTY bars have 1/12 the typical range of 1-minute bars; (4) Volume lookback from 20×1-min (20 min) to 60×5s (5 min) because at 5-second frequency the relevant volume baseline is very local — 20-minute smoothing misses rapid intraday volume regime shifts; (5) Hold time compressed from 5-20 min to 30-90 seconds — we enter earlier (at the absorption bar itself, not the next bar open) and exit on the first-leg resolution rather than the full recovery.
weaknesses: NIFTY index volume (spot) may not perfectly reflect futures volume — absorption signals may be weaker than on individual high-liquidity stocks
Low signal frequency (2-6 trades/day) — statistically limited edge demonstration in 12-day backtest
3x volume spike with 0.03% range can be triggered by scheduled equity index rebalancing flows, which are more predictable (and thus already arbed) than institutional directional programs
No confirmation that the absorption is complete before entry — entering mid-absorption risks riding the rest of the absorption rather than the resolution
